verdict.rationale: W&B ships an official MCP server, documented first-party and in the wandb/wandb-mcp-server GitHub repo. It gives IDEs, coding assistants and chat agents such as Claude Code direct access to Weave traces, evaluations and artifacts, and the site says connected agents can run evaluations and iteration loops. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the server's tool surface and setup/auth configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The W\&B MCP Server gives your IDE, coding assistant, or chat agent direct access to your W\&B data and documentation
Using W&B skills and the MCP server, coding agents like Claude Code connect to Weave.
connects AI assistants to your Weights & Biases data and documentation so they can answer natural-language questions about your runs, traces, evaluations, and artifacts
official MCP server documented at https://github.com/wandb/wandb-mcp-server
